prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Test Companion Personality Traits", "Interact with companion personalities to see how your desktop pet will behave.", "Select Pet Personality"]
1: ["Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "Play with your pet's starter toys while we configure desktop permissions.", "Throw Toy"]
2: ["Finalize Your Pet's Official Adoption", "Sign the certificate to welcome your new desktop companion home.", "Companion Name"]
3: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in to keep your custom companion synced across all your devices."]
4: ["Signing in with an existing account automatically restores all saved pets and progress."]
5: ["Configuring desktop overlay engine and companion animations..."]
6: ["Your chosen story path influences your companion's daily desktop interactions and habits."]
7: ["How to Interact With Your Pet", "Learn quick hotkeys and desktop shortcuts to talk, hide, or play with your companion.", "Desktop Commands Tutorial", "Got It!"]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "Click below to test your pet's first desktop trick or open quick controls.", "Launch Companion", "Call Pet to Cursor"]
9: ["For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with good lighting."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos of the user
